question: Do you ship to the UAE?
answer: Yes, we offer express delivery across all Emirates. Orders placed before 2 PM are eligible for next-day delivery in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

question: Do you ship to Saudi Arabia (KSA)?
answer: Yes, we ship to Saudi Arabia including Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. Delivery typically takes 3-5 business days. Cash on Delivery is available for KSA orders.

question: Do you ship to Pakistan?
answer: Yes, we ship to major cities in Pakistan including Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad. Delivery typically takes 5-7 business days.

question: Do you ship to the UK?
answer: Yes, we ship to the United Kingdom. Standard delivery takes 7-10 business days. Express options are available at checkout.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: We accept returns within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unused, in original packaging, with tags attached. Electronics must be unopened unless defective.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Tabby (Buy Now Pay Later), and Cash on Delivery (UAE and KSA only).

question: What is the free shipping threshold?
answer: Free standard shipping is available on all orders over AED 489. Orders below this amount incur a flat shipping fee of AED 25.

question: Do your products come with a warranty?
answer: Electronics come with a manufacturer warranty (typically 1 year). Fashion and accessories are covered against manufacturing defects for 30 days. Perfumes are non-returnable once opened due to hygiene reasons.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, you will receive an email and SMS with a tracking link. You can also log into your account and view order status under 'My Orders'.

question: Are your products authentic?
answer: Yes. Every item on RRVDXB is sourced directly from official brand distributors or authorized retailers. We guarantee 100% product authenticity and include authenticity paperwork with luxury items.

question: Do you have any discounts or promo codes?
answer: Yes, we run seasonal promotions and flash sales throughout the year. New customers get 10% off their first order. Active promo codes are always listed on our website and sent to subscribed members.

question: Do you have the iPhone 14 in stock?
answer: Our current catalog carries the iPhone 14 Pro Max, iPhone 13 Pro, and iPhone 13 Pro Max. We don't list the standard iPhone 14 at the moment; the iPhone 14 Pro Max is our closest alternative.
